native_pager_objective.design_target: Native C++ layer/tensor pager in llama.cpp — loads active layers, manages residuals, enforces 16GB budget, supports 30B paged inference without swap
native_pager_objective.prototype_target: Standalone C++ pager probe — no llama.cpp integration, validates C++ IO behavior against Python 28AI results
native_pager_objective.future_runtime_target: Native llama.cpp integration via modified model loader and ggml buffer abstraction

hook_points.name: llama_model_loader::load_all_data
hook_points.description: Loads all model tensor data into backend buffer — primary hook for lazy loading
hook_points.risk: HIGH — assumes all tensors loaded before return
hook_points.opportunity: Could be modified to load only active layers

hook_points.name: llama_mmap
hook_points.description: Memory-maps GGUF file with unmap_fragment() for eviction support
hook_points.risk: MEDIUM — page cache dominates real IO
hook_points.opportunity: unmap_fragment() exists — eviction mechanism already present

hook_points.name: llama_model_loader::get_tensor_meta
hook_points.description: Returns tensor metadata without loading data — redirect to pager
hook_points.opportunity: Hook here to redirect tensor loading to pager-managed memory

hook_points.name: llama_model::load_tensors
hook_points.description: Orchestrates tensor loading with use_mmap flag control
hook_points.opportunity: Insert pager layer between tensor creation and data loading

hook_points.name: llama_prt_sidecar_extract pattern
hook_points.description: Existing sidecar loading proven in phase10b_shadow_test.cpp
hook_points.opportunity: Build on proven pattern for residual loading

pager_api.config_struct: prt_pager_config (max_resident_bytes, prefetch_distance, window_size, storage_root, residual_manifest, policy, use_mmap, use_direct_io, checksum_enabled)
pager_api.class: prt_layer_pager with methods: load_layer, prefetch_layer, evict_layer, load_tensor, load_residual, enforce_budget, can_add_layer, resident_bytes, get_stats
pager_api.error_handling: enum class error { FILE_NOT_FOUND, CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, MAP_FAILED, LOAD_FAILED }

loader_level_paging.reason: Too risky — breaks core loader assumptions

sidecar_only_paging.reason: Minimal changes, proven pattern, immediate win for residuals

recommended_v0: Sidecar-only pager + external preprocessor — base model via normal loader, residuals via pager, Q2 base instead of Q4 solves 30B residency without base weight paging

fake_native_prototype.purpose: Validate C++ file IO vs Python 28AI, test read/mmap RSS, checksum, eviction

major_risks.mitigation: Hook at load-time, ensure active tensors always resident
Buffer views, never evict referenced tensors
posix_fadvise DONTNEED, measure cold vs warm
Clear separation: pager manages files, loader creates views

major_risks.risk: Eviction unsafe if graph refs tensor

recommended_next: Phase 28AK: standalone C++ pager probe — prt_pager_probe.cpp with fake GGUF layer files, compare to Python 28AI results
